Paper

Prints the codes exactly as they are set now. Scan the sheets back in any order — every code carries its own number.

Scan a code, then press Next. Arrow keys and the spacebar work too. Order never matters — every code carries its own number.

Camera

Missing frames

Hold this up to the sending screen and press Send Remaining there. Your camera keeps scanning the whole time.

Paste scanned codes
How this works
  1. Scan a code on the other screen with any QR scanner.
  2. Paste the scanned text into the box. The box clears itself, ready for the next one.
  3. Repeat until the bar below is full, then save the file.
  4. Or press Scan with camera and point this phone at the other screen — it collects them on its own.

Scan them in any order. Duplicates are ignored. You can also paste several codes at once.
